content.text: : synthetic purine nucleoside analog with activity against HSV (types 1 and 2), varicella-zoster virus (VZV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV); stops replication of herpes viral DNA by competitive inhibition of viral DNA polymerase (selective toxicity), incorporation into and termination of the growing viral DNA chain, and inactivation of the viral DNA polymerase
: IV (injection site inflammation or phlebitis, transient elevation of SCr/BUN, N/V), PO (GI disturbances, HA, skin rash)

: prodrug; converted to penciclovir in the gut wall and liver; penciclovir is phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase to penciclovir monophosphate, which is then converted to penciclovir triphosphate by cellular kinases; triphosphate inhibits viral DNA synthesis
: has antiviral activity against HSV1/2, VZV, & EBV

content.text: NONE ARE FOR USE IN CHILDREN <2YO
: sedation, cognitive dysfunction, dry mouth, blurred vision
: high sedation, cognitive dysfunction, blurred vision, local anesthetic activity, may lower seizure threshold, decreased HR/BP
-    MOA: H1-receptor antagonist (1st-gen, cross BBB) -> block CNS histamine wakefulness -> sedation (+ anticholinergic)

-    Caution: marked drowsiness (↑ w alcohol/sedatives/tranquilizers) · ask doctor first: breathing problems, glaucoma, trouble urinating (enlrg prostate) · ⍉ use to make a child sleepy · excitability (children)
-    MOA: phenothiazine H1 antagonist (+ D2 block -> antiemetic) -> sedation + anticholinergic
-    Caution: ↓ sz threshold · CI comatose states, phenothiazine hypersensitivity/idiosyncratic rxn
-    BBW: potentially fatal resp depression · CI <2 y (peds ≥2 y: use w caution)
- adults + children ≥12 y: 1-2 tabs (25 mg each)
- allergy: 25 mg qHS (or 12.5 mg b4 meals + on retiring)
- motion: 25 mg BID, 1st dose 1/2-1 h b4 travel, repeat q8-12 h
- N/V: 25 mg, repeat 12.5-25 mg q4-6h prn
